calculation.description: Fade each asset's three-day cross-sectional weakness relative to the median, activated only when the fraction of assets with negative five-day returns indicates broad stress. Cross-sectional z-scoring makes signal scale comparable across regimes.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.0162602), 2023-2024 (+0.0437040), and 2025-2027 (+0.0524626). Signal activated on 393 of 2568 dates; selective coverage is material. The 5-day estimate is based on only 9 observations and should not drive admission.
